content.comment_body: I agree with your points, and although this discussion is several years old, I'm currently facing similar issues. Initially, I didn't realize a [product_name] was needed; I thought the I/O in the unit would be accessible via Modbus, but it isn't. I'm attempting to set up email notifications using a local email server on the site LAN, but it seems this function only works through the phone connection. Is that correct? I also tried using a local time server, but discovered it also requires the phone network. Thanks, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences challenges when configuring email notifications and time synchronization on a [company_name] device, finding that both features depend on connectivity to the phone network rather than the local LAN. They also discover that I/O access via Modbus is not supported without a required base module, highlighting unclear product requirements and connectivity limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to set up email and time synchronization using the local LAN, without relying on the phone network, and wants to access I/O through Modbus.
